meta.text: Photon is a native C++ vectorized engine that replaces parts of the Spark execution engine. The critical point for the exam: your Spark APIs, your SQL, and your DataFrame code do not change at all. Flipping Photon on is a runtime switch, not a rewrite. It is vectorized and columnar — instead of interpreting one row at a time, it processes a batch of column values per CPU instruction, which collapses the per-row interpretation overhead.
